annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidelines are aimed at manufacturers and developers of automated vehicles, of their sub-assemblies and components, and organizations involved in trials or test/validation activities on AVs.
annotation.bound_parties_quote:
Manufacturers and developers of automatic vehicles
Manufacturers and developers of automatic vehicle sub-assemblies and components
Organizations involved in trials or other test/validation activities on AVs
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This document provides a set of initial guidelines for developers of control systems for the safe, secure and effective deployment of automated vehicles (AVs).
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Guidelines for developing and assessing control systems for automated vehicles
